description: This file implements functions for generating and sending network map and station-specific data over a messaging protocol within a software project, likely related to network management or control. It deals with constructing messages, populating network nodes (agents and stations) data, and communicating with other components via message exchanges, with functions for filling in detailed network statistics and topology information.

methods.name: network_map::send_bml_network_map_message
methods.description: Constructs and sends a network map response message containing topology data of agents and stations to a specified file descriptor, based on the database contents, using a messaging protocol.

methods.name: network_map::fill_bml_station_data

methods.name: network_map::send_bml_client_disallow_req_message_to_listeners
